description: This file defines a React component named 'Order' that manages routing for order-related pages within a dashboard, including listing orders, managing customers, and handling 404 errors. It connects to Redux to access user state and conditionally renders routes based on user roles.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A React component that renders order-related routes within the dashboard, with role-based access control.
